notes: Proposed finite Phase A authority; effective for implementation only after this governance PR is genuinely independently reviewed and merged into trusted main. Its presence on the proposal branch is not authority. First document-intake persistence boundary only, not completed FNS verification. Current Deal-bound StorageService must not be reused by fabricating a deal. Use a separate organization-scoped quarantine schema, retain original bounded PDF bytes and server-computed hashes, never accept client signature/trust/verdict flags. Session/user/membership/organization/tenant are derived from the authenticated server context; database delegates to the existing read-only auth.resolve_organization_admin_session function and revalidates before returning replay or writing. The new NOLOGIN/NOINHERIT capability owner may receive only schema USAGE and EXECUTE on that pre-existing read-only function; no auth table grant, function-body change, existing role membership or registration transition is authorized. Runtime may execute only finite intake/read functions, not read/write original tables directly. Original object, scoped idempotency receipt, capacity counters and append-only audit commit atomically. Same actor/scope/key with different bytes or subject conflicts; exact replay cannot bypass current access; content-addressed dedup is scoped to tenant and organization. No default capacity policy; missing reviewed budget fails closed. Explicit total and per-organization byte/receipt quotas, bounded input, locks and database statements are required. Every receipt remains QUARANTINED and authoritative=false. This phase exposes no HTTP route, registers no module in AppModule, schedules no worker and changes no legal/admission verdict. No production trust pin, freshness rule, cryptographic dependency or FNS subscriber access is approved by this manifest. API/authentication keys, source PDFs, CRLs, private keys and binary dependencies must not enter git. Existing auth/registration migration files are immutable. The generated cryptographic inventory pair is allowed only as deterministic output of the unchanged existing generator if the new source files require it. Acceptance must execute the actual proposed SQL on disposable PostgreSQL with a real restricted connection, source-bound read-only auth helper and explicit fixture limitations, including tenant/org isolation, revoked/expired sessions and MFA, credential rollover, replay/conflict/concurrency, direct SQL denials, immutable originals/audit, quotas and rollback. Schema restore/restart, full repository CI, exact-head independent review and final live base/head compatibility remain mandatory before merge. The implementation branch cannot edit this scope or grant itself authority. No use of a homepage-only exception or owner self-audit as independent review. This is separate from #5127 and must not overwrite its 14-path scope. Registration code/behavior unchanged; ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ENFORCEMENT=false; production only REG.RU; no production database mutation or release in this phase; no new mandatory one-time or recurring cost.
